description: Grant access to a Google Doc. With `email`, share with that person as reader/commenter/writer (optionally sending a notification). Without `email`, set anyone-with-link access to that role, or role "none" to disable link sharing. (To revoke a specific person’s access, use unshare_doc.)

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

email.description: person to share with; omit to set anyone-with-link access instead

notify.description: when sharing with a person, send a notification email (default true)

role.description: access level; default writer. "none" (link only) disables link sharing.

name: share_doc
title: Share a doc (person or link)
